# --instructions--

दो फ़ंक्शन लिखें जो दो `Set<String>` लेते हैं (argument labels छोड़ दें) और एक `Bool` लौटाते हैं:
- `canAccess` आवश्यक permissions और दी गई permissions लेता है, और `true` तभी लौटाता है जब हर आवश्यक permission दी गई हो
- `noOverlap` `true` लौटाता है जब दोनों sets में कोई भी permission कॉमन न हो

```swift

        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`canAccess(["read"], ["read", "write"])` को `true` लौटाना चाहिए

```swift
tryCatch(canAccess(["read"], ["read", "write"]) == true)
```

`canAccess(["read", "delete"], ["read", "write"])` को `false` लौटाना चाहिए

```swift
tryCatch(canAccess(["read", "delete"], ["read", "write"]) == false)
```

`canAccess([], ["read"])` को `true` लौटाना चाहिए

```swift
tryCatch(canAccess([], ["read"]) == true)
```

`noOverlap(["read"], ["write"])` को `true` लौटाना चाहिए

```swift
tryCatch(noOverlap(["read"], ["write"]) == true)
```

`noOverlap(["read", "write"], ["write"])` को `false` लौटाना चाहिए

```swift
tryCatch(noOverlap(["read", "write"], ["write"]) == false)
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func canAccess(_ required: Set<String>, _ granted: Set<String>) -> Bool {
    return required.isSubset(of: granted)
}

func noOverlap(_ first: Set<String>, _ second: Set<String>) -> Bool {
    return first.isDisjoint(with: second)
}
```
